verification_kernel.build_status: 62/62 KERNEL-CLEAN (fresh sweep rebuild via lean.exe + LEAN_PATH, .kernel_build/sweep)

extreme_test_phase1_kernel_audit.method: All 62 modules rebuilt from scratch with Lean v4.33.1 into a clean mirror (.kernel_build/sweep) using LEAN_PATH = package olean dirs + sweep dir, then a 383-line driver ran `#print axioms` over every constant.
extreme_test_phase1_kernel_audit.consistency_note: All 192 dependent declarations depend only on the 3 standard Lean axioms plus the single open postulate. No other axiom, sorry, or admit exists.

extreme_test_phase2_mutation.method: Four mutant copies of ConreyZeroFree.lean (M1_sorry, M2_admit, M3_rogue_axiom, M4_fake_proof) were compiled by the real Lean kernel and scanned by scripts/scan_defects.py.
extreme_test_phase2_mutation.conclusion: The Lean kernel accepts sorry/admit/axiom (with warnings); the defect scanner independently catches all four defect classes — detector is necessary, not a kernel duplicate.

extreme_test_phase3_z3_vacuity.method: All 13 z3_tribunal batches executed end-to-end; every claim's premise set independently re-checked for satisfiability to flag vacuous/circular results.
extreme_test_phase3_z3_vacuity.batches_unknown: batch7: 3 UNKNOWN, batch8: 2 UNKNOWN (Z3 cannot decide transcendental 2^(-s))
extreme_test_phase3_z3_vacuity.unsound_batches_14_17: 14 claims across batches 14-17 flagged VACUOUS (7) or CIRCULAR (6); they inject the target conclusion (or an unsatisfiable premise) and must NOT be presented as RH verification.

spectral_verification.dirac_zero_correspondence: NO correspondence: 0-2/20 zeros match (|f|<0.1); average secular error ~5-11; not converging with N. Confirms Hilbert-Polya is an OPEN program, not a result.
spectral_verification.von_mangoldt_counting: PASS: worst |N(T)-N_asym| = 1.8816 at T~396 << O(log T)=5.9824
spectral_verification.yang_mills_mass_gap: 0.44 GeV (ODE toy converging to G_inf; Z3 unsat confirms bounds)
spectral_verification.z3_batch11: 6/6 UNSAT (all trivial real-arithmetic identities about the toy model)

honest_scope: RH is carried as an openly-declared postulate; no module claims a proof of RH. Conditional theorems (BarrierTheorem, stress tests, master theorems) are conditional on this postulate. Spectral/Hilbert-Polya correspondence remains OPEN. The Z3 tribunal is auxiliary arithmetic; batches 14-17 contain vacuous/circular checks and are downgraded accordingly.

z3_telemetry.role: auxiliary consistency checks only (UNSAT verifies stated identities within the SMT theory); NOT a substitute for the Lean 4 kernel. Vacuous/circular claims excluded from the honest score.
